limits.causal_claim: Quality does not establish that nonreversibility or negative modes caused a gain.
limits.cohorts: Each family/seed native_tied freezes its own cohorts; all9 baseline banks precede every candidate. Cross-family comparisons use the shared be_init/native_tied cohorts.
limits.member_pairing: Each actual M1/M4 bank summarized separately; pooled flows, no arbitrary cross-bank member-index pairing.
limits.operator: New-panel be_init Rademacher stem and public shared native local attention; no relationJ/private-local-scorer substitution.
limits.replication: Three fixed optimizer-seed blocks on one graph; no node/member independence or graph-population interval.
limits.selection_population_caveat: All original5274 development nodes selected these states and provide this readout.
